sara_support: FYI customer reporting streaming sessions that terminate with a broken pipe (write EPIPE) after ~3-4 chunks, and our telemetry marks the request as 5xx. ticket #3247. cc @mike_eng @james_sre
sara_support: customer provided a sample request id: rq_0a1b2c3d and logs showing 'write EPIPE' from our gateway node gw-12. They say it happens intermittently from their EU clients.

mike_eng: got it. can you paste the minimal repro steps or a curl command? we should try to reproduce behind a proxy (CF/ALB)
sara_support: reproduce steps from customer (copied):
1) POST /v1/stream with chunked transfer from mobile client behind Cloudfront
2) client reads 2-3 chunks then connection closes with EPIPE
3) portal shows 502/5xx for rq_0a1b2c3d and billing counted as failed token usage

They also included this `curl` they used:
```
curl -v -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Transfer-Encoding: chunked" \
  -d $'--data\n{"prompt":"hello"}\n' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream
```

mike_eng: thanks. trying locally now with a simple nginx reverse proxy to mimic. please also include the full gateway log line (not just EPIPE) if available.

james_sre: quick note: we have heuristics that classify upstream connection resets as 5xx when the server (our gateway) sees the connection drop before finishing response. That can misattribute client-side disconnects as gateway failures.

sara_support: pasted the gateway log for rq_0a1b2c3d: `2025-06-04T15:12:07Z gw-12 INFO req=rq_0a1b2c3d status=streaming write_error=EPIPE client_ip=54.12.34.56 upstream_status=200 bytes_sent=348`

mike_eng: that looks like the gateway successfully started streaming (upstream_status=200) then saw a write_error when writing to client socket. likely client or an intermediate proxy closed. can you confirm customer is behind CloudFront/CF?
sara_support: yes they are fronted by CloudFront + their own edge proxy. they said it only happens for longer responses (>1s). shorter ones ok.

james_sre: this smells like an intermediate proxy idle/keepalive timeout or early FIN during chunked flush. cloudfront has a default idle timeout of 30s but some customers tune edge pools. also some proxies aggressively half-close when they see certain chunk patterns.

mike_eng: repro attempt: ran curl through nginx with `proxy_send_timeout` low and reproduced EPIPE when proxy closed mid-stream. locally gateway logs matched and our classification code marked it as 502.

mike_eng: immediate mitigation: we can change classification to treat client-originated resets (EPIPE, ECONNRESET with bytes_sent>0 and upstream_status=200) as client disconnects (non-5xx) for billing/alerts. will open a patch.

sara_support: customer requests fix ASAP — they want billing corrected for impacted requests. ticketing: filed internal bug RINF-1129 and linked to customer case #3247.


deploy-bot: deploy queued for branch fix/classify-client-reset (job 4278) — rolling patch to telemetry classification starting 2025-06-05 02:00 UTC. :gear:
mike_eng: I'll add additional logs to capture `Connection: close` and FIN timing (tcp_close delta) to better disambiguate proxy half-close vs client app abort. also adding a flag to exclude these from 5xx billing backfill.

james_sre: please also add a metric for `stream.client_reset_classified_as_5xx` so we can monitor regression after the patch.
sara_support: noted. I'll update the customer with repro findings and the queued fix timeline. thanks everyone :pray:
mike_eng: assigned to eng-runtime, will follow up in RINF-1129 with root cause and PR link. if anyone spots other rq-ids with same pattern drop them here.
